video_title: Aaron Judge x Roommates Show LIVE at Fanatics Fest 🗽Yankees Twitter, Being New York Captains & More

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks' turnaround against the Atlanta Hawks
quotes.excerpt: we just kind of looked at each other and were like, I mean we're better than what we're playing.
quotes.quote: I don't know, we just kind of looked at each other and were like, I mean we're better than what we're playing. That's just the way we lost the games, the first three games. Even though we gave me one, we didn't play the way we want to play. Got to give credit to the Hawks for pushing us and then we just found the way to turn it around.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the Knicks' mindset after falling behind in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: we knew that was their best punch and we knew we wasn't playing anywhere close to what
quotes.quote: I think our back was against the wall and you know, we kind of knew what we had to do. We lost two games, you know, one point each game and we knew that was their best punch and we knew we wasn't playing anywhere close to what we could have been. So it was just our ability to just refocus, retool and focus at the task at hand.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's confidence despite playoff adversity
quotes.excerpt: we work way too hard not to be confident in what we got.
quotes.quote: I don't think we were nervous. I think we were more disappointed in ourselves in the way we were playing. But never nervous. We work way too hard not to be confident in what we got. So yeah, I won't say nervous at all.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on why Josh Hart was excluded from the show
quotes.excerpt: they called me beforehand and said, 'Hey Jalen, sorry, we took away Josh's invitation because we know he's not a good role model.'
quotes.quote: They called me beforehand and said, 'Hey Jalen, sorry, we took away Josh's invitation because we know he's not a good role model. He doesn't know what to do in public settings.' And so we just had to revoke that. I was like, honestly, the show is going to run better when he's not there. And it worked out. If you were there, we wouldn't have clean swept.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on maintaining his routine as a champion
quotes.excerpt: when you believe in your work, believe in doing what got you there, you don't change what got you there.
quotes.quote: I think the beauty of it is nothing really changes. When you believe in your work, believe in doing what got you there, and you get to that, you know, the top of the mountain, you don't change what got you there. I think when you do that, it's something foolish. So for me, my off-season is the same thing, working on my body, working on my shot, and trying to figure out ways to be effective and help these guys out.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of moving on after winning
quotes.excerpt: the quicker we move on from this, the quicker we'll be ready to be better next season.
quotes.quote: The quicker we move on from this, the quicker we'll be ready to be better next season.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the importance of staying focused on the job
quotes.excerpt: I try to focus on my job. I let everybody else focus on Twitter.
quotes.quote: I try to focus on my job. I let everybody else focus on Twitter. Obviously, you get 162 games, it gets to be a long season. So, what is your thought process during those tough weeks where the bats aren't going, the pitching comes and goes? I think the biggest thing is just trusting in each other. Sometimes when things aren't going your way, you feel like you got to do it all on your own. And I think that's when things aren't going your way, you really got to dive into your teammates and be like, 'Hey man, I got your back, I know you got my back.'

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his leadership style and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I've always felt like I've been a leader at some point, just throughout growing up.
quotes.quote: It's something that I feel comfortable in. I've always felt like I've been a leader at some point, just throughout growing up. I've always been like a leader on a team. It's fun because you get to see what type of teammates you have. You get to see how they take criticism, how they take positivity and negativity. How do you help push them to be better every single day? And sometimes it's just being a good teammate off the court. You don't have to talk about basketball. It's just having great chemistry.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the honor of being named Yankees captain
quotes.excerpt: getting a chance to be named the Yankee captain is probably my biggest career accolade.
quotes.quote: It's the greatest honor of my career, by far. Getting a chance to be named the Yankee captain is probably my biggest career accolade. But I think the same with you, it's not something that was just given once. It was you earn it every single day. Every time you show up for practice, show up for a game, you're representing your team, but you're also putting making an example of everybody else on the team. Like, 'Hey, this is how you prepare, this is how you work.' This is why you got to see on your chest is because of how you prepare and play the game.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of accountability and honesty
quotes.excerpt: it's always about just holding yourself accountable, being honest with yourself, being honest with the media.
quotes.quote: It's always about just holding yourself accountable, being honest with yourself, being honest with the media questions. I have to be better in certain points. And I turn that next game, I always find a way to obviously be better than I was the last. So it's always about just holding yourself accountable, being honest with yourself, being honest with the media, setting a great example, not just for your teammates but for everyone. Like, 'Hey, this is how I operate on and off the court.'

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the team's confidence when facing large deficits
quotes.excerpt: we're a five and three when we go down by 20.
quotes.quote: When you get down 29, you don't go, 'All right y'all, let's go win the game.' We're down 29, we good. It's always, 'Okay, we're down 29, let's get down, let's go, let's go down 18 by six minutes left in the third.' We get to the fourth, let's, let's be down 12. Let's be down eight points with five minutes left in the fourth. So we just chipping away and I think all of us had the confidence. I think I saw a crazy stat, between last year and this year in playoffs, we're a five and three when we go down by 20. And I think all of us have that confidence in each other knowing that when our back's against the wall, we're going to do whatever it takes to win.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of finishing games strong
quotes.excerpt: finish the game strong, create good habits, so you don't just want to just give this game away.
quotes.quote: Finish the game strong, create good habits, so you don't just want to just give this game away. Everything counts. You want to continue to do the right things over and over and over again because that could give you momentum into the next game.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the atmosphere at Yankee Stadium during playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I've never been in an arena, in an environment like that, man. That was special.
quotes.quote: How loud the Garden was, as they, like, it was just building. Every time you guys kept scoring and get a stop, you score, you get a stop. Like, the energy was just building in that place. I've never been in an arena, in an environment like that, man. That was special, special.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the contagious energy of the Garden crowd
quotes.excerpt: when the Garden gets loud, we start getting high, we start, you know, it's bumping.
quotes.quote: When the Garden gets loud, we start getting high, we start, you know, it's bumping. The other team, they, the lights get a little brighter. But, nah, that's shout out to the fans, man.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the difference between baseball and basketball
quotes.excerpt: I play baseball, play a sport, it's so different, innings, runs, all that.
quotes.quote: I play baseball, play a sport, it's so different, innings, runs, all that. But then to watch you guys just climb your way back, fight through the adversity, you know, the boos, the whatever, the tough moments, a missed shot, a made shot, you guys just, you guys stayed like this. Watching from the fans, you guys stayed just like this. It didn't matter if you just scored, didn't score, like, just the mental toughness out of you guys, man, it's just, it's a treat to watch, treat to watch.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the home-field advantage at Yankee Stadium
quotes.excerpt: it's really such a home-field advantage getting a chance to play in New York at Yankee Stadium.
quotes.quote: It's really such a home-field advantage getting a chance to play in New York at Yankee Stadium that feels like the place is, it's rocking the whole time. And then even going back to the last post-season, just, you know, we're playing the Red Sox in a wild card division and we go down the first game, but then the second night, you know, I think we were down in the second game too and the fans, they were there the whole game supporting us, pushing us, motivating us. You know, we're able to win that series, go on to the Blue Jays series, kind of then go our way. But you, you felt the energy. You know, it didn't matter where down the game, up in the game, the fans were locked in, man. And just playoff baseball, everything matters. Every little play matters, uh, every little mistake is magnified, every good play is magnified, and it's just really, like I said, going back to relying on your teammates, doing the little things, the fundamentals, all that kind of stuff is really, really takes you to that next level.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the importance of consistency and honesty
quotes.excerpt: you got to be consistent. I think that's the biggest thing is consistent if you're good, consistent if it's going bad.
quotes.quote: You got to be consistent. I think that's the biggest thing is consistent if you're good, consistent if it's going bad. You got to be really honest with yourself. I think that's the biggest thing is sometimes if you're not honest with yourself and like, 'Hey, I need to work on this, I need to improve on this,' if you kind of think, 'Oh, you know, I'll get it the next day' or 'Oh, that's not too bad, like, it'll work out throughout the season,' it's like, those need the season ends and all of a sudden you're not making the post-season, you have a bad year, you got to be real honest with yourselves.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the grit of New York fans
quotes.excerpt: I think about New York, what this city goes through, what these fans, what the people in in New York go through
quotes.quote: I think about New York, what this city goes through, what these fans, what the people in in New York go through on a daily basis, the grind they go through to come out here and watch us play. Man, you got to have that same grit and intensity as as New York City.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the evolution of pitching velocity in baseball
quotes.excerpt: when I first came up, you'd have maybe one or two guys, maybe one guy on a team that threw 100 miles an hour.
quotes.quote: When I first came up, you'd have maybe one or two guys, maybe one guy on a team that threw 100 miles an hour. It was like that one guy in the bullpen that you're like, 'I hope we don't have to face this guy.' Let's beat up the starter so that guy doesn't come out. But now, every single guy that they bring out of the bullpen, they're throwing 97 to 100 miles an hour, man, with they got nasty off-speed pitches. The game is just continue to evolve and get better, which I enjoy. Like, it's it's pushing me to get better, you know, I can't just stay the same. I got to evolve, I got to get better.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Judge
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Judge on the team chemistry of the Yankees
quotes.excerpt: I think one thing is special about this group is it's a close-knit group and I think we we can find different ways to win a game.
quotes.quote: I think one thing is special about this group is it's a close-knit group and I think we we can find different ways to win a game. It's not just go up there and hit a homer and our pitching shuts it down, you know, we find ways to move guys over, drive somebody with a base hit, bunt somebody over. And you know, even the past couple weeks, we may have been scuffling, but a different guy every night is showing up to help us win the game. You know, it could be Jazz hitting a homer in the night, it could be Trent Grisham, you know, a base hit that scores two. Uh, it could be like Cody Bellinger, who was a All-Star game MVP, you know, single in the first inning and drive two guys in. So it's just, it's just finding different ways to win a ball game and then our pitching staff is just incredible.
